text:
mei: Nightly int8 bringup for orion-v3 showed deterministic token reordering when ZWJ / narrow space appears between a CJK ideograph and fullwidth numbers. Repro on vertical/ja and vertical/zh samples.
mei: Raw (escaped): "\u660e\u200d\u5e741" expected -> "\u660e\u200d\u5e741" but int8 produced -> "1\u660e\u200d\u5e74".
mei: Quick run used:
```bash
./eval_local.sh --model orion-v3-int8 --locale ja-vertical --samples tests/vertical_furigana/003.json --mode detok_compare
```
tian: run tokenizer-only detok to rule out vocab/export pretokenize changes.
mei: tokenizer-only detok OK on my dev box; fp16 matches. So generation ordering / KV write likely culprit.
alex: note commit 9a7b3e3 touched export pretokenize last week — bisect that.
sophia: triage-bot, please bisect export commits 9a7b3e3..HEAD for orion-v3-int8 on p4d nodes (driver 525.*).
triage-bot: bisect started across 14 commits; will post first failing commit when reproduced.
mei: FP16 generation trace excerpt: [<BOS>, \u660e, \u200d, \u5e74, 1, <EOS>] -> detok "\u660e\u200d\u5e741"
mei: INT8 generation trace excerpt: [<BOS>, 1, \u660e, \u200d, \u5e74, <EOS>] -> detok "1\u660e\u200d\u5e74"
alex: emission order changed; suspect fused int8 attention kernel non-determinism for certain unicode categories.
triage-bot: bisect update: first failing commit identified 9a7b3e3. Repro only when using int8 export path + GPU driver 525 on p4d.
sophia: short-term mitigation: add a locale-aware post-detok pass that reinserts ZWJ/narrowspace between ideograph and following ASCII/fullwidth digit when the original input had it. Ship behind feature flag.
mei: I'll open runtime PR with unit tests using failing samples and a flag for the temporary fix. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.
tian: also need CI nightly that runs detok-parity for a small set of vertical/furigana/ZWJ samples on int8 to catch regressions.
triage-bot: root cause metadata and artifacts attached to INF-1289.
mei: leaving thread open until runtime patch is approved and CI is green. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
